item.title: Warmer weather and sunshine returns Thursday! Followed by storms
item.description: Some sunshine and warmer weather returns to Omaha on Thursday, but it's followed by a few rounds of thunderstorms. We do have a chance at severe weather, too. Here's the latest.

item.title: Staffing shortages drive childcare gap; new report finds Iowa side of metro has highest need
item.description: A new report finds a 20% childcare gap in Pottawattamie, Mills and Harrison counties. 1,000+ children don't have care near home. Experts say low pay and staffing shortages are driving the crisis.

item.title: Girls' basketball state quarterfinals: Millard West, Omaha North, Yutan advance to semis
item.description: 🏀 GIRLS' STATE BASKETBALL: Millard West and Omaha North each won by double digits to advance to Friday's semifinals.
